prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one individual full-body transparent 2D fighting-game pose for Digital Circus Encore.
Image 1 is the approved Cafe Ragatha sprite and the strict authority for this family's identity, costume, palette, proportions, line width and shading. Image 2 is the official DECOTTO poster costume reference: Ragatha is second character from the left. Create a new distinct pose of ONLY Ragatha; keep the same family design.

INVARIANTS: beige doll face and hands, short red yarn hair; blue stitched X-button eye and one white black-pupil eye, red triangular nose. White frilled coif with dark NAVY side bows only, NO tall lavender bow. Dark NAVY puff-sleeve dress, white pleated bib and pale-blue neck bow; white apron with two large pale-blue side bows, pale stitched patch motifs and scalloped white hem. White stockings on TWO legs, dark NAVY chunky platform shoes with the white toe accents on TWO feet. Beige doll hands remain ungloved. No red bows, no generic black maid uniform, no gold shoe buckles, no apron button.

HEAVY ATTACK: forceful two-handed downward hammer-strike toward SCREEN-RIGHT, both beige doll hands clasped together forward at upper chest height, torso twisted and weight lunging onto the front bent leg. Both arms still clearly separate, both shoes fully shown. Strong readable attacking silhouette, no weapon or motion trails.

Output exactly ONE character in ONE pose, whole body fully visible. Portrait canvas, character silhouette at about 72 percent height with generous clear margins around every hand, shoe, hair and coif tip. Side-view gameplay readability, face and body toward SCREEN-RIGHT. Preserve crisp flat color and restrained cel shading. Genuinely transparent RGBA background, fully opaque body and clean antialiased edges. No floor, background, shadow, glow, haze, halo, white sticker outline, text, logo, watermark, props, extra limbs, extra characters, collage or pose sheet.
